## About Us
ORION IT SOLUTIONS is a founder-led digital production and AI engineering studio headquartered in Lahore, Pakistan, serving enterprise and boutique brands across Pakistan and the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah). We engineer high-performance web applications, cinematic 3D visual experiences, and real-time AI conversational systems.

## Core Services

### 1. Website Development
- Custom full-stack web applications engineered with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Next.js.
- Clean architectural design, responsive mobile-first layouts, and enterprise-grade speed optimization.
- Specialized web experiences for luxury architecture, interior design, and bespoke e-commerce brands.

### 2. 3D Interactive Experiences
- Real-time Three.js / WebGL / React Three Fiber interactive viewports and shaders.
- Spatial interactive 3D product showcases, interactive branding emblems, and dynamic canvas rendering.
- Adaptive performance tiers (low, mid, high) ensuring smooth 60fps animations across laptops, tablets, and smartphones.

### 3. AI Voice Receptionists & Agents
- Hazel: Autonomous 24/7 AI voice receptionist powered by Vapi for customer enquiry capture and booking.
- Real-time ultra-low latency voice conversations, voice waveform synchronization, and intelligent qualification.
- Intelligent conversational AI chat integration, webhook automations (Make.com, n8n), and instant CRM routing.
